response.justification: Bogdan is a technically deep and versatile individual contributor with strong developer-tooling experience (test runners, CI/CD, DLang libraries) and some teaching/mentoring exposure, but his resume shows no evidence of formal people management — no direct reports, performance reviews, hiring, or team leadership responsibilities across 15+ years of IC-track titles (Developer, Senior Developer, Staff Engineer). Since this role is fundamentally a people-management position with technical leadership as a secondary component, the core hard requirement (2+ years people management) is unmet, making him a poor fit despite strong technical credentials.
strengths: Extensive experience building developer tools and testing infrastructure (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD setup)
Broad technical range across web, mobile, embedded, and systems programming (DLang, TypeScript, C/C++, Swift)
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing and mentoring via workshops, talks, and courses (FOSS4G, Selenium course, Refactoring Dojos)
concerns: No evidence of formal people management or direct-report responsibility anywhere in the work history
Career has been entirely IC-track (Developer/Senior/Staff titles) with no manager or lead-of-team roles
No Master's/PhD and limited depth in mobile-platform specialization relevant to the ecosystem focus

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools / testing infrastructure background
No organizational change leadership or manager-level title history
